stats.notes: No Common Data Set is published; admission counts are from the McNeese IRE factbook (fall 2025 first-time freshmen: 4,017 applied, 3,140 accepted = 78%, 1,321 enrolled, 1,308 full-time + 13 part-time). Applicants and admits are not split by residency, so the international admit rate is unknown. Enrolled first-time freshmen by residency: 1,191 Louisiana, 87 out of state, 43 foreign (the country table shows 59 foreign from 23 countries, mostly Nepal 20, Canada 6, Mexico 5; the two tables disagree). GPA, class rank and test-submission rates are not published. College Navigator (fall 2024) shows 3,902 applicants, 78% admitted, and ACT submitted by 86% and SAT by 7% of enrolled students. Undergraduate enrollment 6,055 and non-resident alien undergraduates 399 are fall 2025 Cowboy Facts figures.

cds_test_policy.notes: IPEDS (College Navigator, fall 2024): SAT/ACT are 'not required, but considered (test optional)'.
